1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1.strategy: The safe retreat: the knight goes home, so the pawn on e4 has cost White two moves and given Black space. In return White's structure is untouched, and the advanced pawn may become a target.

1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Nh4.strategy: Sidesteps to the rim instead of retreating: the g-pawn guards the knight, so ...Qxh4 loses the queen to gxh4. But the knight is far from the centre and open to ...Be7, and Black keeps the space gained.
1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Nh4.name: Hungarian Opening: Reversed Norwegian Defence

1.g3 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1 Nf6.strategy: Develops a piece and supports the e4-pawn, so the advanced pawn is no longer loose. Black keeps the space it has gained, and White still has to decide how to challenge the pawn.
